_comment: Axis flight model (spike 13, flight_core::AxisTuning), switched with F7. TODO(initiator): every value here is a placeholder picked near the classic model, not designed. Ship space: forward -Z, right +X, up +Y. cruise_speed m/s for full stick in any direction (stick normalised into a ball); boost_speed_* m/s caps at full boost (at least cruise_speed). accel m/s² per axis and direction (what the thrusters give; with the assist on they also hold against gravity and drag, so a side below 9.81 cannot hold the ship rolled on its side); boost_accel multipliers at full boost (the brake always gets them). linear_decay and angular_decay 1/s: the assist asks for decay times the error (saturated far from the goal, exponential near it). rate rad/s at full stick (pitch and yaw share an ellipse), boost_rate multipliers, angular_accel rad/s². precision: full below full_below m clearance, off above off_above m (the clearance counts less the distance the thrust upwards needs to stop the descent), speed cap in m/s along the ground (climbing away from the ground is not capped), landing_share of it for the descent, rate_share of the turn rates. g_safety: limit in g per direction of the felt acceleration (forward and up press the pilot into the seat); it also scales pitch and yaw down at speed so a coupled turn (plus holding against gravity) stays inside the limit.
